description: Sleep Music | Raga Yaman Night Drone | 3 Hours of deep, continuous Indian drone music to help you fall asleep and stay asleep all night.

If your mind is still running when the lights go off — let this drone carry it down. Three hours of warm, unbroken tanpura resonance in Raga Yaman, the classical evening raga, with no melody to follow and no percussion to pull you back. Just a deep, dark bed of sound to sink into.
🎧 HOW TO USE — play at low volume, screen off. The drone is continuous and loops seamlessly; there is nothing to wait for. If you wake in the night, let it guide you back down.
⏱ BEST FOR — falling asleep fast · staying asleep · night-time anxiety · deep rest · yoga nidra practice

🎵 ABOUT — Raga Yaman is the great evening raga of Indian classical music, associated for centuries with settling the mind at dusk. This session renders it as a pure night drone: warm low tanpura resonance, very slow harmonic swells, no interruptions.
